display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard} with ${accounts.authority} as its authority; its guards (prices, dates, limits) show only as bytes

docs: The accounts the active guards of the chosen group need, in the order the guard set lists its guards: the account that receives a SOL payment (solPayment), the payer's token account and the destination token account of a token payment (tokenPayment, token2022Payment, with its mint and program), the token account and mint of a token burn, the token account of a token gate, the gatekeeper token, the allow-list proof PDA, the mint counter PDA of a mint limit, the NFT accounts of an NFT gate, burn or payment (and the NFT payment's destination), the third-party signer, the allocation tracker, and the freeze escrow PDA and its token accounts of a freeze payment.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} mints NFT ${accounts.nftMint} of collection ${accounts.collectionMint} from candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} through candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard}; what it costs is set by the candy guard's guards, not by this transaction

docs: The accounts the active guards of the chosen group need, in the order the guard set lists its guards: the account that receives a SOL payment (solPayment), the payer's token account and the destination token account of a token payment (tokenPayment, token2022Payment, with its mint and program), the token account and mint of a token burn, the token account of a token gate, the gatekeeper token, the allow-list proof PDA, the mint counter PDA of a mint limit, the NFT accounts of an NFT gate, burn or payment (and the NFT payment's destination), the third-party signer, the allocation tracker, and the freeze escrow PDA and its token accounts of a freeze payment.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.minter} mints NFT ${accounts.nftMint} of collection ${accounts.collectionMint} from candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} through candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard}; what it costs is set by the candy guard's guards, not by this transaction

docs: The accounts the routed guard's action needs: for the allow list, the proof PDA, the System program and optionally the minter; for a freeze payment, the freeze escrow PDA, the authority, the System program and, to thaw or unlock, the NFT's and escrow's token accounts; for the allocation guard, its tracker PDA, the authority and the System program.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} runs the ${data.args.guard} guard's action of candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard} for candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine}
${accounts.authority} hands the authority of candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard} to ${data.newAuthority}
${accounts.candyMachineAuthority} takes the mint authority of candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} back from candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard}, so it mints without the guard
${accounts.authority} replaces the guards of candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard}; the new guards (prices, dates, limits) show only as bytes
${accounts.authority} closes candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard} and takes its rent
${accounts.candyMachineAuthority} makes candy guard ${accounts.candyGuard} the mint authority of candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine}, so it mints only through the guard
